description.en-US: Idle Fantasy is a free and open source offline idle RPG inspired by classic MMORPGs. Train skills, fight in dungeons, craft gear, and complete quests. No internet connection, account, or ads required. Features • 23 trainable skills: Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting, Farming, Thieving, Smithing, Cooking, Fletching, Crafting, Firemaking, Runecrafting, Herblore, Construction, Prayer, Mercantile, Agility, Slayer, Attack, Strength, Defense, Ranged, Magic, and Hitpoints • Session-based training: Start a session and close the app. Come back up to an hour later to collect your loot and XP. Agility reduces session time. • 29 dungeons: Fight solo bosses and enemies to earn combat XP, coins, and rare drops. Equip weapons and armour to deal more damage. • Crafting system: Smelt bars, cook fish, fletch bows and arrows, craft jewellery. Consume gathered materials and earn XP and items. • Prayer: Bury bones collected from combat to earn Prayer XP. • Equipment system: Equip weapons, armour, tools, and jewellery to boost stats and skill efficiency. • Quest system: 189 quests spanning all skills. Earn XP rewards on completion. • Pet system: Rare pets can drop while training skills. Each pet provides a permanent XP boost to their linked skill. • Achievements: Track milestones across levelling, combat, quests, and collections. • NPC Shop: Buy supplies and sell your gathered resources for coins. • No ads. No accounts. No internet required. Your save data stays on your device. • Translations: Partial and full translations available for 20 languages. Idle Fantasy is free software released under the GPL-3.0 licence. Source code is available on the project repository. Get updates faster Add the official Idle Fantasy repository to F-Droid to receive updates as soon as they are released, instead of waiting for the main F-Droid index to catch up. 1. Open F-Droid and go to Settings → Repositories 2. Tap + and paste: https://idlefantasy.tristinbaker.xyz/fdroid/repo 3. Search for Idle Fantasy, open the app page, and under Repositories set Idle Fantasy as the preferred source.

• Boss kills now show up in the session collection popup's Kills list
• Kills left over after completing a slayer task now roll into the next foretold task when it targets the same enemy
• The Armory now sorts items by their translated names instead of their English names

• Seasonal bounty missions now open the dungeon their target enemy actually lives in, instead of always the event's first dungeon
• Rapidly queueing mercantile trade routes now shows a confirmation for every tap; identical back-to-back confirmations used to be silently dropped, making the buttons feel unresponsive
• Fixed a crash when opening Housing for player

• Fixed overlapping text in the spell selector when translated rune names made the rune count line too long
• Monument touch now resets at your daily reset hour instead of midnight
• Boss coin soft cap now resets at your daily reset hour instead of midnight
• Slayer now appears under Combat instead of Support in the Profile skills list
• Switching characters now immediately backs up the outgoing character to its own backup file
• Repeating an Infinite Tower session no longer shows a meaningless

• The What's New dialog now correctly lists the recent updates; the 1.14.6 hotfix entry was missing from it
• Re-release of the 1.14.6 hotfix: collecting sessions and starting queued sessions froze the game indefinitely in 1.14.5; nothing was lost, and stuck sessions collect normally after updating
